scope: Replace automatic all-country culture generation on Reader mount with an explicit country action in Library; save and reopen through the existing actor-owned Reader device queue.
testBoundaries: Production hook mount sends no request
Explicit action requests only one country and current language pair
Saved pair reopens offline while a different pair does not reuse it
Incomplete and malformed alignment is rejected
Concurrent click and unmount cannot duplicate/save a late response
A failed device save retries the retained text without another generation
Production hook output survives real Reader device-cache reconstruction and remains actor-isolated
actualTrial: Fresh hosted guest Reader, normal first-visit language/welcome flow, explicit Mexico request, saved My Texts entry, refresh and reopen. Chrome DevTools Network was set to Offline for the exact test tab; saved Mexico reopened, unsaved Spain showed Connect to create a new reading. Normal network and viewport were restored.
limits: The real browser trial used guest device storage, not a new signed-in cloud-save acceptance run
Offline trial used an already loaded Reader; no offline cold-start, device audio or scored-exam claim
The API remains available; this removes automatic UI requests, not server-side rate-limit risk
Generated culture content is optional AI text, not reviewed module content or proficiency evidence
No app promotion, schema change, exam answer, mastery, certificate or content approval occurred
